description: Search a retailer's Instacart storefront for priced products, browse a department/aisle, look up specific items by ID, or pull a retailer's store overview.

aisleSlug.description: Which department/aisle (a.k.a. "collection") to browse within the selected retailer, e.g. `9797-crackers`, `produce`, or `dynamic_collection-sales` (retailer-wide deals). Run `mode=listAisles` first to get the exact slugs available for your chosen Retailer, or copy one from an Instacart collection URL: instacart.com/store/<retailer>/collections/<slug>.
aisleSlug.title: Aisle / department slug (mode=browseAisle)

brandContains.description: Keep only items whose brand name contains this text (case-insensitive).
brandContains.title: Brand name contains

customRetailerSlug.description: Any Instacart retailer slug, e.g. `whole-foods-market` or `sprouts-farmers-market`. Find a retailer's slug in its Instacart storefront URL: instacart.com/store/<slug>/storefront. Leave empty to use the Retailer dropdown instead.
customRetailerSlug.title: Custom retailer slug (overrides Retailer above)

inStockOnly.description: Drop items that are marked out of stock.
inStockOnly.title: In-stock only

itemIds.description: Full Instacart item IDs to look up, e.g. `items_74-17444603` (copy from a `search`, `browseAisle`, or `storeOverview` result's `itemId` field). Must all belong to the same Retailer selected above.
itemIds.title: Item IDs (mode=productDetail)

maxPrice.description: Drop items priced above this amount (whole dollars).
maxPrice.title: Max price (USD)

minPrice.description: Drop items priced below this amount (whole dollars).
minPrice.title: Min price (USD)

minRating.description: Drop items with an average customer rating below this (out of 5). Items without a public rating are kept (unknown, not zero).
minRating.title: Min rating (0-5)

onSaleOnly.description: Keep only items currently discounted from their regular price (has a `regularPrice` higher than `price`).
onSaleOnly.title: On sale only

postalCode.description: Five-digit US ZIP code to price this retailer's storefront at, e.g. `10001`. Leave empty to use Instacart's default location for the session. The actor resolves the matching shop and zone before scraping; a ZIP this retailer does not serve fails the run instead of silently returning another market's prices.
postalCode.title: Delivery ZIP code (optional)

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Leave empty to let the actor choose a working connection automatically (a proxy is never required). Set this only if you want to use your own proxy configuration.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

retailerSlug.description: Which Instacart-partnered retailer's storefront to scrape. Pick from the list, or use "Custom retailer slug" below to supply any Instacart retailer slug not in this list.
retailerSlug.title: Retailer

searchQuery.description: Keyword to search for within the selected retailer's storefront, e.g. `milk`, `organic eggs`, `paper towels`. Results are filtered so every returned item's name/brand/category contains each significant word of your query (generic words like "organic" are ignored for this check). Note: this is a substring check, not full product understanding, so on rare occasions an item that happens to contain all your query words in an unrelated context (e.g. a "milk chocolate"-flavored candy matching a search for "almond milk") can still slip through.
searchQuery.title: Search query (mode=search)

title: Instacart Storefront Price Scraper Input
